referenceDna.annotatedDescription: A dark technician-at-condenser photograph supports a left-aligned plainspoken repair promise, two contact actions and a low trust detail rail. Thin service-area utility line, white brand row, service links, call number and contrasting schedule action. Large friendly sans headlines, compact status labels and concise visitor-centered task descriptions. The page sequence runs from technician hero to symptom-choice cards to service photograph grid toward metro coverage diagram, before-you-call FAQ, lead action and footer. Authentic technician scenes fill a service photo grid, while a simple circular metro diagram handles locality without pretending to be a literal map. Only transferable composition, hierarchy and service-routing mechanics are retained.
